name: Jean Brookes
source:
Faction: Terran
Birthday: January 18, 2381
Place of Birth: Austria
Occupation: Major
Affiliation: United Terran Vanguard

Profile:
Major Jean Brookes has earned a reputation for being a strict leader, as well as a superb strategist. She is widely renowned as one of the UTV‘s most elite officers, garnering commendation after commendation in every one of her exploits.

Though Junius hasn’t met her personally, some have said that if they were given the chance to work together, the Fleet would obtain a double-edged sword because of their similar line of thinking.

She has taken the callsign of “Gungnir Leader“, for herself, leading a battle group mainly composed of the most promising UTV officers who are also marines.
translation:
阵营：地球人
生日：2381年1月18日
出生地：奥地利
职业：少校
所属：联合地球先锋队

简介：
让·布鲁克斯少校以严格的领导风格和卓越的战略才能闻名。她被广泛认为是UTV最精锐的军官之一，每次行动都屡获嘉奖。

虽然朱尼厄斯从未亲自见过她，但有人说，如果他们有机会并肩工作，舰队将得到一把双刃剑，因为两人的思路十分相似。

她为自己取了“冈格尼尔队长”的呼号，率领一支主要由最有前途、同时也是海军陆战队员的UTV军官组成的战斗群。
